reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Optional fingerprint requirement for licensure applications
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to reflect permissive 'may require'. Verified sub 1: healing arts board may require fingerprints for § 345.020 license or § 345.021 provisional license applications for audiologists, SLPs, aides, and assistants.

headings.title: Highway patrol fingerprint submission if required
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to reflect conditional trigger ('If the state board... requires'). Verified sub 2: applicants submit fingerprints to the highway patrol for state and federal background checks.

headings.title: Central repository processing, FBI search, and board record access
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: fingerprints and fees go to highway patrol central repository and FBI under § 43.540; patrol notifies board; records accessible notwithstanding § 610.120.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.016 (bid 57255), all three subsections, and source note (L. 2025 S.B. 71 merged with S.B. 81 & 174). Revised subs 1 and 2 titles to preserve permissive 'may require' and conditional trigger.

headings.title: Independent licensure, dual practice, and certificate display
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: independent licensure/registration in SLP or audiology, dual licensure if qualified, and prominent display at place of practice.

headings.title: Licensure requirement for practice and physician exemption
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: prohibits unlicensed practice/holding out under §§ 345.010–345.080, preserving other licensed professions and exempting licensed physicians and surgeons.

headings.title: Speech-language pathologist title restrictions and criminal penalty
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: bars holding out or using listed SLP titles/abbreviations without a valid license; violation is a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Audiologist title restrictions and criminal penalty
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: bars holding out or using listed audiologist titles/terms without a valid license; violation is a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Registration requirement for assistants and aides
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: bars holding oneself out as an SLP assistant, SLP aide, or audiology aide without registration under §§ 345.010–345.080.

headings.title: Business entity employment of licensed personnel
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 6: allows corporations, partnerships, trusts, or associations to engage in SLP or audiology business without entity licensure if employing licensed natural persons in direct practice.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.020 (bid 18384), all six subsections, and history notes (L. 1973 through A.L. 2015 S.B. 107). Verified independent/dual licensure, physician and other-licensee exemptions, class B misdemeanor title prohibitions, assistant/aide registration, and entity employment rule. Retained all six titles.

headings.title: Provisional license requirements for clinical fellowship
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(3): clinical fellows must hold a provisional license; board 'may issue' upon accredited practicum/academic completion, application with supervision plan and character evidence, and fee.

headings.title: Provisional license duration and twelve-month extension conditions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: effective 1 year; may be extended 12 months only to complete postgraduate clinical experience, provided national exam passed and master's degree held.

headings.title: Examination passage deadline within twelve months
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: applicant must pass board-promulgated or board-approved exam within 12 months of provisional license issuance.

headings.title: Accredited degree completion deadline within twelve months
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: applicant must complete master's or doctoral degree requirements from a CAA/ASHA or board-approved accredited program within 12 months of provisional issuance.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.021 (bid 51032), all four subsections with subdivisions (1)-(3), and source note (L. 2022 H.B. 2149 § 345.022). Verified clinical-fellowship provisional licensure, 1-year term plus 12-month conditional extension, and 12-month exam and accredited-degree deadlines. Retained all four titles.

headings.title: Exemptions from licensure and regulatory provisions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(7) and revisor footnote (*§ 345.015(12) renumbering): exempts federal employees, certified teachers of the deaf, supervised students, chapter 334 physicians/surgeons, OSHA industrial audiometric technicians, pre-Jan 1, 2016 DESE-certified public school SLPs, and supervised clinical-hour trainees.

headings.title: Loss of exemption for outside compensated work and clinic supervision
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: removes sub 1(1) and (6) exemptions for fee-compensated outside work and requires licensed supervisors when college/university clinics charge a fee.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.025 (bid 18386), both subsections with subdivisions (1)-(7), history notes, and revisor footnote (*reference to subdivision (11) changed to (12) under § 3.060 following H.B. 2149, 2022). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Board administration, licensure, examination, and enforcement duties
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: board administers/enforces §§ 345.010–345.080, evaluates applicants, supervises exams, issues licenses, and investigates apparent violations.

headings.title: Board hearings, records, and minutes maintenance
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: board conducts hearings and keeps records and minutes necessary for orderly dispatch of business.

headings.title: Ethical standards rulemaking and hearing instrument consumer protection
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: board adopts ethical-practice rules and hearing-instrument consumer-protection rules meeting or exceeding §§ 346.007–346.250.

headings.title: Advisory commission meeting schedule and special sessions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: commission holds at least one regular annual meeting and special meetings on chair call or request of at least two members.

headings.title: Chapter 536 compliance prerequisite for administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: no rule under §§ 345.010–345.080 is effective unless promulgated pursuant to chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.030 (bid 18387), all five subsections, and history notes (L. 1973 through A.L. 2007 merged bills). Noted body refers to 'board' in subs 1-3 and 'commission' in sub 4. Retained all five titles.

headings.title: Written purchase agreement and used-product disclosure requirements
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: licensees dispensing products for remuneration must provide plain-English purchase agreements, with 'used', 'recased', or 'reconditioned' markings and guarantee terms if not new.

headings.title: Required contents of audiologist hearing instrument purchase agreements
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2(1)-(7): lists required disclosures for audiologist hearing-instrument purchase agreements (licensee info, specs, down payment, trial length/fees, return rights/notice, and remanufacturer details).

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.033 (bid 18388), both subsections with subdivisions (1)-(7), and source note (L. 2007 H.B. 780 merged with S.B. 308). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Employment of board personnel within appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: board 'may', within appropriations, employ board personnel defined in § 324.001(11)(4) as necessary.

headings.title: Board expense payments from healing arts fund
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: all board expenses are paid only from appropriations from the board of registration for the healing arts fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.035 (bid 36060), both subsections, and history notes (L. 1973 through A.L. 2018 S.B. 975 & 1024 Revision). Verified permissive personnel hiring and healing-arts-fund expense restriction. Retained both titles.

headings.title: Collection and deposit of fees into healing arts fund
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: except as otherwise provided in § 345.045, division collects moneys and transmits to DOR for deposit into the healing arts fund.

headings.title: Biennial fund transfers to hearing instrument specialist fund
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: effective July 1, 2008, odd-numbered-year transfers up to $61,000 to offset § 346.060(2) renewal-fee decreases, with <=25% step-downs and budget-process requests.

headings.title: Use of funds for unlicensed hearing aid enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: permissive authority ('may be used') to assist in enforcing statutes against unlicensed hearing-aid fitting and dispensing.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.045 (bid 18391), all three subsections, and history notes (L. 1973 through A.L. 2007 merged bills). Verified fee deposit, odd-year transfers starting July 1, 2008 up to $61,000, and permissive enforcement spending. Retained all three titles.

headings.title: License and registration renewal schedule, application, and disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: renewal by board-set date (no less than 3 years) with required disclosures of addresses, license info, final disciplinary actions, and physical/mental fitness.

headings.title: Mailing of renewal applications and licensee responsibility
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: blank renewal forms mailed to last known address, but failure to mail or receive does not relieve renewal and fee duties.

headings.title: Renewal fees and continued competence requirements
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3(1)-(2): renewal fee plus board-set continued competence conditions (including up to 30 triennial CE hours, exams, self-evaluation, peer review, appraisal, or simulation).

headings.title: Renewal and practice restrictions during license suspension
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: license suspended under § 345.065 expires on schedule and may be renewed, but does not authorize practice or violation of the suspension order until reinstated.

headings.title: Disciplinary revocation nonrenewal and reinstatement fee terms
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: license revoked under § 345.065 expires on schedule and may not be renewed; reinstatement after expiration requires last regular renewal fee plus any board-set late fee.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.051 (bid 34741), all five subsections with subdivisions (1)-(2), and history notes (L. 1990 through A.L. 2017 merged bills). Verified >=3-year renewal cycle, mailed-form disclaimer, fees/competence criteria, and suspended/revoked license rules. Retained all five titles.

headings.title: Definitions for military licensure reciprocity
headings.reviewNote: Revised title to reflect all six defined terms (Board, Commission, License, Military, Nonresident military spouse, Resident military spouse), not just military spouses.

headings.title: Reciprocity application for out-of-state and military licensees
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: allows SLP/audiologist licensees with >=1 year valid current licensure in another state, military branch/unit, territory, or DC to apply.

headings.title: Licensure waiver timelines and expedited military spouse processing
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3(1)-(2): 6-month waiver of exam/education/experience requirements (with optional Missouri-law exam) for general applicants, or 30-day waiver and issuance for eligible military spouses.

headings.title: Disqualifications from waiver and unresolved disciplinary matters
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4(1)-(2): bars waiver for revocation, pending complaint/investigation, bad standing, disqualifying criminal record, or non-current license; board 'may deny' if out-of-state discipline is unresolved.

headings.title: Retention of board authority to deny licensure under disciplinary grounds
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: preserves board authority to deny a license under § 345.065.

headings.title: Board regulatory jurisdiction over reciprocity licensees
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 6: subjects reciprocity licensees to board jurisdiction and all Missouri SLP/audiologist practice rules.

headings.title: Mandatory payment of licensing fees under reciprocity
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 7: section does not waive any applicant fee-payment requirement.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.052 (bid 51034), all seven subsections with subdivisions, and source note (L. 2022 H.B. 2149). Revised sub 1 title from 'Definitions of nonresident and resident military spouses' to 'Definitions for military licensure reciprocity' because sub 1 defines six terms (Board, Commission, License, Military, and both military spouse categories).

headings.title: License renewal fees, dual certification, and lapsed license reinstatement
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: renewal fees, single-license fee treatment for dual SLP/audiologist credentials, free duplicates for multi-location practice, reinstatement fee for lapsed licenses, and permissive reexamination after >3-year lapse.

headings.title: State fee exclusivity and prohibition on municipal taxes
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: § 345.051 and § 345.055 fees are exclusive; municipalities may not require bonds, exams, license fees, or occupational taxes.

headings.title: Fee-setting rulemaking authority, revenue limits, and fund transfers
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3(1)-(2): fees set by rule under § 536.021 to cover administration costs and, effective July 1, 2008, required § 345.045(2) transfers.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.055 (bid 18394), all three subsections with subdivisions (1)-(2), and history notes (L. 1973 through A.L. 2007 merged bills). Retained all three titles.

headings.title: Refusal to issue or renew, probationary license, and hearing rights
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: board 'may refuse' issuance or 'may, at its discretion,' issue a probationary, restricted, or limited license/registration for sub 2 causes; written notice and 30-day AHC review window for either party.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for disciplinary complaint before administrative hearing commission
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2(1)-(21): board 'may' file a chapter 621 AHC complaint against holders or lapsed/surrendered holders for 21 listed causes, including § 324.012 criminal offenses.

headings.title: Disciplinary sanctions authorized upon administrative hearing commission finding
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: chapter 621 proceedings; upon AHC finding, board 'may' censure, impose probation up to 10 years, suspend up to 3 years, indefinitely restrict/limit practice, or revoke.

headings.title: Injunctive relief against statutory violations and board immunity
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: board 'may apply' for injunction without bond or proof of inadequate legal remedy; board and advisory commission members are not individually liable for applying.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.065 (bid 48464), all four subsections including all 21 subdivisions of sub 2, and history notes (L. 1973 through A.L. 2020 H.B. 2046). Verified permissive 'may' framing for refusal, probation/restriction, AHC complaints, discipline limits, and injunctive relief. Retained all four titles.

headings.title: Advisory commission establishment, duties, and examination approval
headings.reviewNote: Corrected note to match text. Verified sub 1: establishes the Advisory Commission for Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists to guide/advise/recommend to the board, approve the § 345.050 exam, and assist under §§ 345.010–345.075.

headings.title: Commission composition, member qualifications, terms, and nominations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: post-Aug. 28, 1997 7-member commission (3 SLPs, 3 audiologists, 1 voting public member), 3-year terms, 2-consecutive-term limit with 2-year lapse, and association 5-name recommendation lists.

headings.title: Member compensation, travel expenses, and administrative staffing
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: compensation up to $70/day set by division director plus actual/necessary expenses; staff provided by healing arts board.

headings.title: Annual officer elections, meeting notice, and quorum rules
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: annual meeting electing chairman and secretary, additional meetings with 10-day member notice, and majority quorum.

headings.title: Board removal of commission members for cause after hearing
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: healing arts board 'may remove' a member for misconduct, incompetency, or neglect of official duties after written notice and opportunity to be heard.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 345.080 (bid 18397), all five subsections, and history notes (L. 1986 through A.L. 2015 S.B. 107). Tightened sub 1 reviewNote to match exact statutory duties (removed unstated 'examine credentials'); retained all five titles.
